speakers: Steve Cohen (founder, Point72, owner of the Mets)
summary: Steve Cohen at Sohn 2025 sees slowing growth, 45% recession odds, a tariff rate near 14-17% and a range-bound market with a higher floor after the policy pivot. His approach is analysis first, pattern recognition second, a consistent process through slumps and lowered expectations after an easy 2024; the rest is personal reflection.

coverage.note: recession odds, tariff rate, Fed, multiples, market range, new regime for PMs
little upside, sideways markets, analysis vs pattern recognition, self-doubt and process
lower expectations after 2024; mentoring, motivation and work-life balance (no market content)
personal life, stress at home, Mets ownership; no market content
Mets casino project, quick hits (toppy market, preparation, drawdowns), outro

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: we think it'll probably be, you know, like a 45% chance of recession
claims.claim: Point72 puts recession odds at about 45% (May 2025) with significant growth slowing from tariffs, though the odds fell after the China tariff reversal.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: I thought it was going to be like the 16 to 20 range, and now it's probably lower, 14 to 17% rate perhaps
claims.claim: The effective US tariff rate is expected near 14-17% (cut from a 16-20% expectation) after the China tariff retreat.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: we don't think the Fed's going to act right away because they're still going to be worried about inflation from tariffs
claims.claim: The Fed will not cut quickly when growth slows because tariff inflation keeps it cautious.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: what kind of multiple do you put on these numbers
claims.claim: With growth of about 1.5% next year, valuation (the multiple) is the key question, so high multiples with slowing growth give little upside.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: I want to see when the data turns down how the market's going to react and that'll tell me a lot about whether we're priced correctly or not.
claims.claim: The market's reaction to weak data (does it hold up or fall) shows whether prices already discount slowing growth.
claims.testable: yes - event study of data surprises

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: what Trump done you know did recently actually raises the floor and eliminates perhaps you know the dire scenario
claims.claim: After the policy pivot, downside is limited to the 10-15% below the April lows and equities should trade in a range for a while.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: I was trying to get them to to think that we're in a different regime and what worked in the past is not going to work this year
claims.claim: After the easy 2024 (multiples rose, everything worked), 2025 is a different regime, so PMs need a higher bar and caution with data-dependent and tariff-exposed names.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: with slowing growth and like I'll say it again multiples you know being on the higher side I think that's kind of a a mix that doesn't give you much upside
claims.claim: Slowing growth plus elevated multiples leaves little index upside, so be more conservative and expect a sideways market.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: markets don't have to go up every year
claims.claim: Markets can go sideways for long stretches, which is historically normal.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: I think it all comes back to facts or or what you perceive to be facts. And then the second part is I think pattern recognition, right?
claims.claim: In noisy markets rely first on analysis of facts, then on pattern recognition from experience, since episodes rhyme without being identical.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: the only thing you can go go to is go back to your process
claims.claim: During losing streaks return to a consistent process, because good processes can still produce bad stretches (a baseball slump analogy).

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: I don't create the world, I got to live in the world. If the world gets presented to me, that's more difficult. You got to lower your expectations.
claims.claim: After an extraordinary year (2024), PMs should lower return expectations when the environment is harder, instead of pressing for repeat performance.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: Right now the market feels toppy.
claims.claim: Cohen's quick call in May 2025 was that the market looks toppy.

claims.speaker: Steve Cohen
claims.quote: The part of the process you cannot skip is preparation.
claims.claim: Preparation prevents many mistakes, and first drawdowns are normal scars to learn from rather than disasters.
